description: A glossy red subway train with a rounded front stands at a tiled platform in a dim, warmly lit station. Commuters in fedoras, long overcoats, hats and gloves crowd the platform, and one man in a dark coat gestures toward a woman boarding. The style is an oil painting with visible brushwork, with tiled pillars and a low ceiling. No visible text, frame or border; the painting runs edge to edge.
